regressions.source: Governance.sol:40 initializeWithRevision: new VotingConfig[](2) (zero-initialised elements), then the two configs
regressions.issue: The 2-iteration zeroing loop of the memory array, which the old text unrolled into constant addresses, is now a do-while; the free pointer after it is symbolic, so the two configs are written at _4 + k instead of constant addresses.
regressions.rule: Unroll a loop whose trip count is a small constant (here 2) when that makes the pointers after it constant again.

improvements: 38 more revert reasons decoded; implied Panic(50) bounds checks of the voting-config loop dropped and the length > 0 check dominated by length == 2 removed (b3809b13); memory arrays decoded from calldata read as cd[_param4 + 4]; forwardMessage's bytes argument decoded (Array(len=96, ...)); if/else-revert pairs as early reverts; P6 54 -> 0; 378 fewer lines.

summary: One minor regression: initializeWithRevision's 2-element array zeroing is now a do-while and the configs after it get symbolic addresses. Otherwise better: 38 more revert reasons decoded, implied checks dropped, 378 fewer lines.
